qualification: N10.3 one-variable calibration after #351: raise only the EGO trajectory planner max_velocity_m_s parameter from 0.8 to 1.2 m/s per axis, based on the #351 rejected optimizer candidates reaching 1.04976 m/s/axis. Runtime EGO/PX4 speed guards remain disabled; speed telemetry is observation-only.
rationale: #351 used horizon=5.0 m, max_velocity=0.8 m/s/axis and max_acceleration=0.25 m/s^2/axis. EGO produced repeated candidate curves but rejected all; across 178 logged feasibility summaries the maximum candidate axis velocity was 1.04976 m/s, and maximum candidate axis acceleration was 0.78 m/s^2. Test only max_velocity=1.2 m/s/axis (rounding above the velocity observation); preserve max_acceleration=0.25, horizon, inflation, spawn, goal, observation-only runtime speed policy and every other gate. Rejected candidate speeds were not flown; measure actual EGO/PX4 speed independently.
